# EventZ <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Events](BlitzPlus-Events)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EventZ:Int32
```

**Returns:** The Z value, 0 if the event has none.

## Description

Gives the third value of an event. Most events leave it at 0, it is only filled in when a [HotKeyEvent](HotKeyEvent) says what to put there. The official help lists this command as undocumented.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Z", 20, 20, 200, 100, Desktop(), 15)
HotKeyEvent 30, 2, $4242, 1, 2, 3
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $4242 Then SetStatusText win, "Z is " + EventZ()
Until e = $803
```
